Портативний пасивний пристрій для пошуку.text: A portable passive device for finding and detecting compatible analog and digital video signals. This manual explains how to prepare the
for use, detect and analyze signals, view compatible analog video, save results, and update the firmware.

⚠️ Пристрій працює виключно на прийом і: ⚠️ The device is receive-only and transmits nothing.
Аналогове відео PAL / NTSC (FM-модуляція: Analog PAL / NTSC video (FM modulation); DJI Mavic detection; test detection of Wi-Fi cameras and Walksnail FPV. Digital video is not decoded.
DJI Mavic — виявлення сумісного цифровог: DJI Mavic — detection of a compatible digital video signal at up to 2.5 km; digital video is not decoded, and detection by control signal is not implemented yet. Analog video: reception and image viewing in the 540–6000 MHz range — about 10 km; above 6000 MHz — 3.5–5 km. These figures apply to the stock antennas in favorable open-terrain conditions and are not guaranteed for every scenario. Actual range depends on transmitter power and altitude, frequency, terrain, buildings, vegetation, radio interference, and the position of the device.
Перша версія з одним акумулятором — оріє: First version with one battery — approximately up to 3 hours; second version with two batteries with a total capacity of 10,000 mAh — up to 6 hours. Runtime depends on how intensively the device is used.

Рівень сигналу не є вимірюванням відстан: Signal level is not a distance measurement. It cannot be converted directly into meters, because it depends on transmitter power, frequency, antennas, obstacles, and the position of the object.
Зі штатними всеспрямованими антенами при: With the stock omnidirectional antennas the device also does not determine the exact direction, azimuth, or coordinates of the source. While moving, you can only roughly estimate the direction in which the signal gets stronger or weaker.
Для приблизного пошуку напрямку можна пі: For rough direction finding, you can connect a compatible directional antenna and rotate it while watching the signal level change. The antenna must match the required frequency range, the SMA connector, and the electrical characteristics; models approved by the manufacturer are recommended. The device still will not calculate azimuth or coordinates automatically.
